an10.83:1.1: athakho āyasmā puṇṇiyo yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā puṇṇiyo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
an10.83:1.2: ko nu kho bhante hetu ko paccayo yena appekadā tathāgataṃ dhammadesanā paṭibhāti appekadā na paṭibhātīti.
an10.83:2.1: saddho ca puṇṇiya bhikkhu hoti no ca upasaṅkamitā neva tāva tathāgataṃ dhammadesanā paṭibhāti
an10.83:2.2: yato ca kho puṇṇiya bhikkhu saddho ca hoti upasaṅkamitā ca evaṃ tathāgataṃ dhammadesanā paṭibhāti
an10.83:3.1: saddho ca puṇṇiya bhikkhu hoti upasaṅkamitā ca no ca payirupāsitā …
an10.83:3.3: paripucchitā ca no ca ohitasoto dhammaṃ suṇāti …
an10.83:3.4: ohitasoto ca dhammaṃ suṇāti no ca sutvā dhammaṃ dhāreti …
an10.83:3.5: sutvā ca dhammaṃ dhāreti no ca dhatānaṃ dhammānaṃ atthaṃ upaparikkhati …
an10.83:3.6: dhatānañca dhammānaṃ atthaṃ upaparikkhati no ca atthamaññāya dhammamaññāya dhammānudhammapaṭipanno hoti …
an10.83:3.7: atthamaññāya dhammamaññāya dhammānudhammapaṭipanno hoti no ca kalyāṇavāco hoti kalyāṇavākkaraṇo poriyā vācāya samannāgato vissaṭṭhāya anelagaḷāya atthassa viññāpanīyā
an10.83:3.8: kalyāṇavāco ca hoti kalyāṇavākkaraṇo poriyā vācāya samannāgato vissaṭṭhāya anelagaḷāya atthassa viññāpanīyā no ca sandassako hoti samādapako samuttejako sampahaṃsako sabrahmacārīnaṃ neva tāva tathāgataṃ dhammadesanā paṭibhāti.
an10.83:4.1: yato ca kho puṇṇiya bhikkhu saddho ca hoti upasaṅkamitā ca payirupāsitā ca paripucchitā ca ohitasoto ca dhammaṃ suṇāti sutvā ca dhammaṃ dhāreti dhatānañca dhammānaṃ atthaṃ upaparikkhati atthamaññāya dhammamaññāya dhammānudhammapaṭipanno hoti kalyāṇavāco ca hoti kalyāṇavākkaraṇo poriyā vācāya samannāgato vissaṭṭhāya anelagaḷāya atthassa viññāpanīyā sandassako ca hoti samādapako samuttejako sampahaṃsako sabrahmacārīnaṃ
an10.83:4.3: imehi kho puṇṇiya dasahi dhammehi samannāgatā ekantaṃ tathāgataṃ dhammadesanā paṭibhātīti.
